import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

class Dijkstra {
    int N;
    List<List<Pair>> E;

    public Dijkstra(int n) {
        N = n;
        E = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            E.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
    }

    public void insert(int u, int v, int w) {
        E.get(u).add(new Pair(v, w));
    }

    public int[] dijkstra(int start, int end) {
        int[] dist = new int[N + 1];
        Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        dist[start] = 0;
        PriorityQueue<Pair> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Integer.compare(b.first, a.first));
        pq.offer(new Pair(0, start));
        while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
            Pair top = pq.poll();
            int w = -top.first;
            int u = top.second;
            if (u == end) return dist;
            if (dist[u] < w) continue;
            for (Pair edge : E.get(u)) {
                int v = edge.first;
                int w2 = w + edge.second;
                if (dist[v] > w2) {
                    dist[v] = w2;
                    pq.offer(new Pair(-w2, v));
                }
            }
        }
        return dist;
    }
}

class Prim {
    int N;
    List<List<Pair>> E;

    public Prim(int n) {
        N = n;
        E = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            E.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
    }

    public void insert(int u, int v, int w) {
        E.get(u).add(new Pair(v, w));
    }

    public void execute(long[] cost) {
        int[] dist = new int[N + 1];
        boolean[] selected = new boolean[N + 1];
        Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        dist[1] = 0;
        PriorityQueue<Pair> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Integer.compare(b.first, a.first));
        pq.offer(new Pair(0, 1));
        cost[0] = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < N; k++) {
            if (pq.isEmpty()) break;
            Pair top = pq.poll();
            int w = -top.first;
            int u = top.second;
            if (selected[u]) {
                k--;
                continue;
            }
            cost[0] += w;
            selected[u] = true;
            for (Pair edge : E.get(u)) {
                int v = edge.first;
                int w2 = edge.second;
                if (!selected[v] && dist[v] > w2) {
                    dist[v] = w2;
                    pq.offer(new Pair(-w2, v));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

class Floyd {
    int N;
    int[][] E;

    public Floyd(int n) {
        N = n;
        E = new int[N + 1][N + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(E[i], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        }
    }

    public void setRC(int r, int c, int w) {
        E[r][c] = w;
    }

    public int getRC(int r, int c) {
        return E[r][c];
    }

    public void execute() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            E[i][i] = 0;
        }
        for (int k = 1; k <= N; k++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                    if (E[i][k] != Integer.MAX_VALUE && E[k][j] != Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                        E[i][j] = Math.min(E[i][j], E[i][k] + E[k][j]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

class DFS_Graph {
    List<List<Pair>> E;
    int[] A;
    int N;

    public DFS_Graph(int n) {
        N = n;
        E = new ArrayList<>();
        A = new int[N + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            E.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
    }

    public void insert(int u, int v, int w) {
        E.get(u).add(new Pair(v, w));
    }

    public void insert_fb(int u, int v, int w) {
        E.get(u).add(new Pair(v, w));
        E.get(v).add(new Pair(u, w));
    }

    public int dfsAll(int start, int end) {
        boolean[] visited = new boolean[N + 1];
        return dfs(start, end, visited);
    }

    public int dfs(int start, int end, boolean[] visited) {
        if (start == end) return 1;
        visited[start] = true;
        for (Pair edge : E.get(start)) {
            int v = edge.first;
            if (!visited[v]) {
                if (dfs(v, end, visited) == 1) return 1;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    public void setA(int a, int b) {
        A[a] = b;
    }

    public int dfsAll2() {
        int[] visited = new int[N + 1];
        int seq = 0, ret = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            dfs2(i, visited, ++seq);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            int sumW = 0;
            for (Pair edge : E.get(i)) {
                sumW += edge.second;
            }
            if (ret < sumW) ret = sumW;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public int dfs2(int start, int[] visited, int seq) {
        visited[start] = seq;
        int ret = A[start];
        for (Pair edge : E.get(start)) {
            int v = edge.first;
            int c = edge.second;
            if (visited[v] < seq) {
                if (c == -1) {
                    edge.second = dfs2(v, visited, seq);
                }
                if (ret < edge.second) ret = edge.second;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public void g(Scanner sc) {
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        DFS_Graph dg = new DFS_Graph(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            int b = sc.nextInt();
            dg.insert(a, b, 0);
        }
        int start = sc.nextInt();
        int end = sc.nextInt();
        int c;
        if (dg.dfsAll(start, end) == 1) c = -1;
        else if (dg.dfsAll(end, start) == 1) c = 1;
        else c = 0;
        System.out.println(c);
    }
}

class Pair {
    int first;
    int second;

    public Pair(int first, int second) {
        this.first = first;
        this.second = second;
    }
}
